arabic text:
AY MUNKARO NAKIR SUNLO MERI SADA TUM KO NAHI
PATAA ZAINAB KA HU(N) FAKIR.
YEH KABR NAHI HAI(N) USKAA HAI AZA KHANA JO
BINT-E-MURTAZA HAI SHABBIR KI HAMSHIR
english translation text:
O Munkar and Nakir, hear my call—you do not
know: I am a beggar of Zainab. This is
not a grave; it is an azakhana belonging
to the daughter of Murtaza, the sister of Shabbir.

arabic text: AY NAKIRAYN SAWAALO KI NA BHARWAR KARO,\nFARSHE MAJLIS HAI YAHA(N) AWO ADAB SE BETHO\nSHEH KI MAJLIS HO BAPA HUKM DETE HAI YAHI
english translation text: O Nakirain, do not overwhelm me with questions.\nThis is the floor of a majlis; come and sit with respect.\nWhen the King’s majlis is established, this is the command.

arabic text: TUM BHI AATE THE DAR-E-BINTE ALI PE AKSAR\nSAJDA-E-SHUKR KIYA MAINE BHI US CHOWKHAT PAR\nJAB BHI SAJDE ME JABEE(N) MEIN BHI KEHTA THA YAHI
english translation text: You too would often come to the door of the daughter of Ali.\nI too performed the prostration of gratitude at that threshold;\nwhenever my forehead touched the ground, I would say the same.

arabic text: KON HAI MAULA MERA TUM KO BATATA HU ABHI\nAAWO BETHO TUMHE TALKEEN SUNATA HU ABHI\nKYA TUMHE YAAD NAHI HAI MADADGHAR MERI
english translation text: Who is my Master? I will tell you now.\nCome, sit—I will recite the talqeen to you.\nDo you not remember who my helper is?

arabic text: DAAGH-E-MATAM JO HAI TEHRIR MERE SINE PAR\nSAATH AAYA HAI MERE MERA HAWALA BANKER\nHAA(N) KAFAN PAR BHI MERE YE IBARAT HAI LIKHI
english translation text: The mark of matam written upon my chest\nhas come with me as my testimony.\nYes, these words are written even upon my shroud.

arabic text: TUM KO BATALATU HU ME ASHK AZAA KI QIMAT\nEK AANSOO KI BARABAR NAHI BAAGH-E-JANNAT\nRONE WAALO KE LIYE PARTI HAI NADE ALI
english translation text: Let me tell you the worth of the tears of mourning:\nall the gardens of Paradise do not equal a single tear.\nFor those who weep, Nad-e-Ali is recited.

arabic text: SUNKE YE BAAT NAKIRAYN NE KHAALIK SE KAHAA\nAY KHUDA BANDA-E-ZAINAB HAI YE BANDA TERA\nKYA SAWAAL ISSE KARE ISKE LAB PAR HAI ABHI
english translation text: Hearing this, Nakirain said to the Creator:\n‘O God, this servant of Yours is a servant of Zainab.\nWhat question can we ask him while this remains upon his lips?’
